messages.context: 作为花园访客提出委托
messages.text: Sometimes, after a long day of fighting incomprehensible horrors in the Crimson Isle, you just want to kick back.
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 有时候,在猩红岛和难以名状的恐怖战斗了一整天后,人只想放松一下。

messages.text: Time to kick back and put my feet up, at least until tomorrow!
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 该放松下来,把脚翘起来了——至少在明天之前!

messages.text: Do you have any idea how many Mushroom Bulls I'll have to go through just to find a single high-quality mushroom?
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 你知道为了找到一颗高品质蘑菇,我得翻遍多少蘑菇牛吗?
